features: Exact2016-11-03 LongMarch5/Yuanzheng2 first-flight combination; two core stages plus upper stage, four3.35m liquid boosters around5m core.

First-flight short5.2m-class bulbous head and four radially mounted3.35m boosters around5m core. This orthographic representative shows two side boosters and one front booster; the fourth rear booster is occluded by the core. Not LongMarch5B/YZ2 or later lengthened fairing.
